Validation and limits

Evidence 024 records npm ci, 65 app and 36 proto tests, typecheck/build, and four live read-only browser recoveries on dev/preview at 1440/390 px. All passed. The initial dev optimizer import failure after ci was resolved by restarting dev and remains documented.

T01 checkbox selections are Victor’s attestations, not independent reproductions of every temporal check. Chrome 152.0.7977.76 and MetaMask 13.46.1 are operator-entered versions. Dev/preview VC screenshots and the public export show application verification; full credentials/signatures were not retained or independently replayed. Browser recovery used no wallet provider.

Desktop ECDSA only; native BBS is excluded. The 62 audit findings, peer incompatibilities, dfns license omissions and event eligibility questions remain. One approved hash was verified; no global uniqueness audit is claimed. T03 is inactive.

This report uses original Victor-supplied screenshots and existing project evidence. No new third-party visual assets, libraries, signatures or transactions were added.
